verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs describe building templates that package your environment, launching custom templates, and configuring any Docker image's run options and entrypoint in the GUI or CLI. A community comment says renters can deploy images. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling a user's own image from a (private) registry with auth, and independent hands-on corroboration of running a fully custom image.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: Build a template - Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click.
Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.
You can open custom ports for any docker image using -p arguments in the docker create/run options box in the image config editor pop-up menu.
The docker image entrypoint is the main run process, which you can override in the GUI or CLI (--entrypoint).
These are pre-configured environments that you can use as-is, or you can tweak them to your own requirements.
